description: [FREE: 25 calls/day, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402] Converts between about 30 currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CAD, AUD, CHF, CNY, INR, MXN, BRL, ...) at the European Central Bank's euro reference rates, published once per business day around 16:00 CET. Cross rates go through the euro exactly as the ECB publishes them. Give a date (last 90 days) or get the latest; a weekend or holiday uses the last published rates and says which. Returns each rate, its inverse, the converted amount (rounded to the currency scale you choose) and the rate date. Reference rates are for information: banks and card networks add their own margins.

amount.description: amount to convert as a decimal string, default "1"

date.description: rates for this date (within the last 90 days); default the latest

scale.description: decimal places of converted amounts, default 2

to.description: one or more target codes, e.g. ["EUR", "GBP"]

name: fx_rate
title: Currency conversion at official ECB reference rates (dated, never guessed)
